data.gender_notes: Badyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'badara', meaning 'to open' and 'to cultivate', Badyah is a name that symbolizes growth and nurturing. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a girl in Islamic culture, reflecting the importance of gardening and cultivation in the Quran. The name Badyah carries the meaning “Gardener, cultivator” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Badyah usually hope their child will grow to embody gardener, cultivator and live with faith, good character and purpose.
